name: Model Audit

inputs.name: What the model is for (LBO, merger, operating, DCF)
Which outputs matter most (returns, EPS, valuation range)

steps.title: Check structural integrity
steps.detail: Balance sheet balances in every period. Cash flow ties to balance-sheet cash. Circularity is intentional and switched.

steps.title: Hunt hardcodes
steps.detail: Plugs inside formula chains are the classic silent killer. Every hardcode is either an input (move it) or an error (fix it).

steps.title: Trace the drivers
steps.detail: Do key outputs respond correctly to key inputs? Flex growth, margin and leverage and watch the directionality.

steps.title: Audit the assumptions
steps.detail: Internally consistent? Revenue growth vs capacity, margins vs history, exit multiple vs entry logic.

steps.title: Stress the edges
steps.detail: Zero growth, downside case, covenant limits — models that break at the edges have hidden fragility in the base case.

steps.title: Report by impact
steps.detail: Errors ranked by effect on the decision output, each with location, issue and suggested fix.

steps.title: Delegate 1
steps.detail: Scanning for hardcodes, broken links and inconsistent formulas across rows

steps.title: Delegate 4
steps.detail: Drafting the issue log with cell references

sections.name: Structured error/risk report
sections.detail: A systematic review of an Excel model for hardcodes, broken links, circularity, sign errors, inconsistent assumptions and balance-sheet breaks — ordered so the highest-impact errors surface first.

outputs.sourcePolicy: Every figure cites the page or filing it was read from; nothing is stated without a source.

verification.description: Each flagged "error" is actually wrong — some hardcodes are deliberate inputs
The balance check formula itself isn’t a plug
Suggested fixes don’t break dependent calculations
Issues ranked by output impact, not discovery order
Every issue has a cell reference and a proposed fix
Structural checks (B/S, CF tie) documented as pass/fail

humanCheckpoints: Which issues are material to the decision vs cosmetic
Whether the model’s core architecture is trustworthy or needs a rebuild
What to say to the model’s owner, and how

display.jobToBeDone: Find the errors in a financial model before someone senior does.
